# Architecture Visualization

This directory contains the architecture model and supporting artifacts for Anki Audio Quick Editor.

## Artifacts

| File | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `workspace.dsl` | Structurizr C4 DSL | Human-authored architecture model (System Context, Container, Component) |
| `webviews.yaml` | YAML | WebView injection map: which Anki hooks register which Svelte bundles |
| `README.md` | Markdown | This file |

## Diagrams (auto-generated)

All diagrams in `docs/graphs/` are generated from source code. Regenerate them with:

```bash
python3 scripts/dev.py graphs-all
```

Verify they are current:

```bash
python3 scripts/dev.py graphs-check
```

### Python Dependency Graphs (SVG)

Generated by custom AST-based import analysis + Graphviz.

| Graph | Scope |
|-------|-------|
| `graphs/python-overview.svg` | Full package (entry points + max depth 3) |
| `graphs/python-audio-core.svg` | Audio processing, batch operations, prosody |
| `graphs/python-editor.svg` | Editor adapters and bridge |
| `graphs/python-bridge.svg` | WebView bridge infrastructure |
| `graphs/python-infra.svg` | Runtime manager, config, diagnostics |

### Svelte/TypeScript Dependency Graphs (SVG)

Generated by regex-based import analysis of TypeScript/Svelte source + Graphviz.

| Graph | Scope |
|-------|-------|
| `graphs/svelte-overview.svg` | All 3 entry points (settings, editor, batch) |
| `graphs/svelte-editor.svg` | Editor-inline components (110 files) |

### Anki Bridge Message Maps (Mermaid)

Generated by AST-based parsing of Python bridge dispatchers + regex-based parsing of TypeScript bridge modules.

| Diagram | Scope |
|---------|-------|
| `graphs/bridge-messages-overview.mmd` | System-level: 4 webview contexts → bridges → Python |
| `graphs/bridge-messages-editor.mmd` | 36 editor `aqe:*` commands → handlers |
| `graphs/bridge-messages-settings-batch.mmd` | Settings + batch `bridge:{json}` commands |
| `graphs/bridge-messages-window-contract.mmd` | 22 Python→JS `window.__aqe*` entry points |

### WebView Injection Map (Mermaid)

Generated from `docs/architecture/webviews.yaml`.

| Diagram | Scope |
|---------|-------|
| `graphs/webview-injection.mmd` | Hooks → Python entry points → Svelte apps → bundles |

## Viewing the C4 Model

Use Structurizr Lite (free, browser-based):

```bash
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 -v "$PWD/docs/architecture:/usr/local/structurizr" structurizr/lite
```

Then open http://localhost:8080.

## Related Tools

- `python3 scripts/dev.py architecture-report` — Text/JSON architecture contract inspection
- `python3 scripts/dev.py arch` — Import-linter boundary enforcement
- `python3 scripts/dev.py graphs-all` — Regenerate all diagrams
- `python3 scripts/dev.py graphs-check` — Verify diagrams are current (CI gate)
